literal: Jingzong, Part One
idiomatic: Jingzong, Part One

literal: Emperor Jingzong Xiaocheng Kangjing, taboo name Xian, style name Xianning, childhood name Mingyi.
idiomatic: The Emperor Jingzong, posthumous title Xiaocheng Kangjing, personal name Xian, courtesy name Xianning, childhood name Mingyi.

literal: Second son of Emperor Shizong; his mother was Empress Huaijie, née Xiao.
idiomatic: He was the second son of Emperor Shizong; his mother was Empress Huaijie of the Xiao clan.

literal: At the Chaige Rebellion the Emperor was only four years old.
idiomatic: During the Chaige Rebellion the Emperor was only four years old.

literal: When Muzong took the throne, he was raised in Yongxing Palace.
idiomatic: After Muzong ascended the throne, he was raised in Yongxing Palace.

literal: Once grown, Muzong drank heavily and neglected governance.
idiomatic: Once he came of age, Muzong drank heavily and neglected governance.

literal: One day the Emperor discussed current affairs with Han Kuangsi; Yelü Xianshi stopped it.
idiomatic: One day the Emperor spoke with Han Kuangsi about current affairs, and Yelü Xianshi cut him off.

literal: The Emperor understood and spoke no more.
idiomatic: The Emperor took the hint and said no more.

literal: In the nineteenth year of Yingli, on wuchen day of the first spring month, he entered for audience; Muzong said, "My son is already grown and may be entrusted with government."
idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Yingli, on wuchen day in the first spring month, he came for an audience; Muzong said, "My son is already grown and may be entrusted with government."

literal: On jisi day Muzong was assassinated; the Emperor led Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli, Palace Attendant Xiao Siwen, and Southern Chancellery Commissioner Gao Xun with a thousand armored horsemen in haste to the spot.
idiomatic: On jisi day Muzong was assassinated; the Emperor led Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli, Palace Attendant Xiao Siwen, and Southern Chancellery Commissioner Gao Xun at the head of a thousand armored horsemen in haste to the scene.

literal: At dawn he reached the traveling palace and wept bitterly.
idiomatic: At dawn he reached the traveling palace and wept in deep grief.

literal: The ministers urged him to take the throne, and he thereupon ascended the imperial seat before the coffin.
idiomatic: The ministers urged him to ascend, and he took the throne before the coffin.

literal: The officials submitted the honorific title Emperor Tianzan, granted a grand amnesty, and changed the era name to Baoning.
idiomatic: The officials submitted the honorific title Emperor Tianzan; a grand amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Baoning.

literal: Because Palace Front Inspector Yelü Yila and right Pishi xiangwen Xiao Wulizhi had failed to guard the palace strictly, both were executed.
idiomatic: Palace Front Inspector Yelü Yila and right Pishi xiangwen Xiao Wulizhi were beheaded for lax palace security.

literal: In the third month, on bingxu day, he entered the Supreme Capital and made Xiao Siwen Northern Chancellery Commissioner.
idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu day, he entered the Supreme Capital and appointed Xiao Siwen Northern Chancellery Commissioner.

literal: Prince of Taiping Yansage fled into Shato.
idiomatic: Prince of Taiping Yansage fled into Shato.

literal: On jichou day yilijin Nianmugun, who had secretly joined Yansage, was executed.
idiomatic: On jichou day yilijin Nianmugun was put to death for secretly siding with Yansage.

literal: On guisi day Yansage entered court.
idiomatic: On guisi day Yansage came to court and submitted.

literal: On jiawu day Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xiao Siwen was additionally made Northern Prime Minister.
idiomatic: On jiawu day Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xiao Siwen was also made Northern Prime Minister.

literal: On jihai day Southern Chancellery Commissioner Gao Xun was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin.
idiomatic: On jihai day Southern Chancellery Commissioner Gao Xun was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin.

literal: That summer, on the wushen new moon of the fourth month, Prince of Taiping Yansage was advanced to Prince of Qi; Prince of Zhao Xiyin was changed to Prince of Song; Longxian was enfeoffed as Prince of Ping, Shao as Prince of Wu, Daoyin as Prince of Shu, Bishe as Prince of Yue, Dilie as Prince of Ji, and Wan as Prince of Wei.
idiomatic: That summer, on the wushen new moon of the fourth month, Prince of Taiping Yansage was advanced to Prince of Qi; Prince of Zhao Xiyin was renamed Prince of Song; Longxian was made Prince of Ping, Shao Prince of Wu, Daoyin Prince of Shu, Bishe Prince of Yue, Dilie Prince of Ji, and Wan Prince of Wei.

literal: In the fifth month, on wuyin day, Consort Xiao was established as empress.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuyin day, Consort Xiao of the Xiao clan was made empress.

literal: On bingshen day he shot the willow branch to pray for rain.
idiomatic: On bingshen day the Emperor shot the willow branch to pray for rain.

literal: The officials requested that the Emperor's birthday be made the Tianqing Festival, and this was approved.
idiomatic: The officials asked that the Emperor's birthday be declared the Tianqing Festival, and the request was granted.

literal: On renyin day Han sent Li Kuangbi, Liu Jiwen, Li Yuansu, and others to offer congratulations.
idiomatic: On renyin day Han sent Li Kuangbi, Liu Jiwen, Li Yuansu, and others to offer congratulations on the accession.

literal: That winter, in the tenth month, he traveled east to Congtan.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, the Emperor traveled east to Congtan.

literal: In the eleventh month, on the jiachen new moon, he performed the fire-wood enthronement rite, sacrificed to Mount Muye, and halted at Crane Valley.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiachen new moon, he performed the fire-wood enthronement rite, sacrificed to Mount Muye, and encamped at Crane Valley.

literal: On yisi day Xiao Siwen was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei, and Northern Grand Prince Wuzhi was advanced to yuyue.
idiomatic: On yisi day Xiao Siwen was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei, and Northern Grand Prince Wuzhi was promoted to yuyue.

literal: In the second year, on dingwei day of the first spring month, he went to the Huang River.
idiomatic: In the second year, on dingwei day in the first spring month, the Emperor went to the Huang River.

literal: That summer, in the fourth month, he visited the Eastern Capital and offered sacrifice at the temples of the Abdication Emperor and Shizong.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, he visited the Eastern Capital and made offerings at the temples of the Abdication Emperor and Shizong.

literal: In the fifth month, on guichou day, he traveled west.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guichou day, the Emperor traveled west.

literal: On yimao day he halted at Pansdao Ridge; bandits murdered Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xiao Siwen.
idiomatic: On yimao day the court halted at Pansdao Ridge, where bandits murdered Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xiao Siwen.

literal: In the sixth month he returned to the Supreme Capital.
idiomatic: In the sixth month the Emperor returned to the Supreme Capital.

literal: That autumn, in the seventh month, right Pishi xiangwen Xianshi was made Northern Chancellery Commissioner.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, right Pishi xiangwen Xianshi was appointed Northern Chancellery Commissioner.

literal: In the ninth month, on xinchou day, evidence was obtained that the empress's uncle Xiao Haizhi and Haili had killed Xiao Siwen; both were executed, and Siwen's brother Shendu was exiled to Huanglong Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinchou day, proof was obtained that the empress's uncle Xiao Haizhi and Haili had murdered Xiao Siwen; both were put to death, and Siwen's brother Shendu was banished to Huanglong Prefecture.

literal: That winter, in the twelfth month on gengwu day, Han sent tribute envoys.
idiomatic: That winter, in the twelfth month on gengwu day, Han sent tribute envoys.

literal: In the third year, on jiayin day of the first spring month, right yilijin Xidi sent men presenting captives of Dilie; an edict granted rewards to meritorious officers and soldiers.
idiomatic: In the third year, on jiayin day in the first spring month, right yilijin Xidi sent men with captives taken from Dilie; an edict rewarded the officers and soldiers who had earned merit.

literal: On gengshen day the Petition Drum Office was established.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the Petition Drum Office was established.

literal: On xinyou day Southern Capital Military Commissioner Duke of Wei Han Kuangmei was enfeoffed as Prince of Ye.
idiomatic: On xinyou day Southern Capital Military Commissioner Han Kuangmei, Duke of Wei, was enfeoffed as Prince of Ye.

literal: In the second month, on guiyou day, he traveled east.
idiomatic: In the second month, on guiyou day, the Emperor traveled east.

literal: On renwu day the duo'e commissioner was sent to Uighur.
idiomatic: On renwu day a duo'e commissioner was dispatched to the Uighurs.

literal: On jichou day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On jichou day the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

literal: In the third month, on dingwei day, Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli was made Khitan traveling palace chief steward.
idiomatic: In the third month, on dingwei day, Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli was appointed chief steward of the Khitan traveling palace.

literal: That summer, in the fourth month on dingmao day, Shizong's consorts Chuoluo and Puge used malevolent sorcery and were granted death.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on dingmao day, Shizong's consorts Chuoluo and Puge were executed for sorcery.

literal: On jimao day he sacrificed to Mount Muye and performed the rebirth rite.
idiomatic: On jimao day the Emperor sacrificed to Mount Muye and performed the rebirth rite.

literal: On bingxu day he returned from the eastern tour.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the Emperor returned from the eastern tour.

literal: On wuzi day Xiao Shendu was executed.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Xiao Shendu was put to death.

literal: In the sixth month, on bingzi day, Han sent envoys inquiring after the Emperor's health; from then on they came month after month.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingzi day, Han sent envoys to inquire after the Emperor's health, and such missions thereafter arrived every month.

literal: On dingchou day Uighur sent tribute envoys.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the Uighurs sent tribute envoys.

literal: That autumn, in the seventh month on xinchou day, Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xianshi was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on xinchou day, Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xianshi was appointed Northwest Route pacification commissioner.

literal: In the eighth month, on jiaxu day, he went to Autumn Mountain.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiaxu day, the Emperor went to Autumn Mountain.

literal: On xinmao day he sacrificed at the tomb of his elder brother Hou; Hou was posthumously enfeoffed as crown prince with posthumous title Zhuangsheng.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the Emperor sacrificed at the tomb of his elder brother Hou, who was posthumously enfeoffed as crown prince with the posthumous title Zhuangsheng.

literal: In the ninth month, on yisi day, wet-nurse fathers Palace Attendant Daliedie, Grand Guardian Chubu, Grand Guardian Po'er, nurse Huishi, yaya, and others were granted households and cattle and sheep in differing amounts.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yisi day, the wet-nurse fathers Palace Attendant Daliedie, Grand Guardian Chubu, Grand Guardian Po'er, nurse Huishi, yaya, and others received grants of households, cattle, and sheep according to rank.

literal: The former residence's supply envoys were also made the tame-horse section, with officials appointed to administer it.
idiomatic: Envoys from the former princely residence were also organized as the tame-horse section, with officials appointed to oversee it.

literal: On renzi day he visited Guihua Prefecture.
idiomatic: On renzi day the Emperor visited Guihua Prefecture.

literal: On jiayin day he went to the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor went to the Southern Capital.

literal: That winter, in the tenth month on jisi day, black and white sheep were sacrificed to the spirits.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on jisi day, black and white sheep were sacrificed to the spirits.

literal: On guiwei day Han sent tribute envoys.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Han sent tribute envoys.

literal: On bingxu day Biegude and Tuyuhun came to offer tribute.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the Biegude and Tuyuhun sent tribute.

literal: In the eleventh month, on gengzi day, yuyue Yan Nili of Luchu River and others led four hundred fifty households to submit and asked to be enrolled in palace registers.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengzi day, yuyue Yan Nili of Luchu River and others led four hundred fifty households to submit and petitioned to be enrolled in palace registers.

literal: An edict retained their households and distributed them among the Dunmu, Jiqing, and Yongxing palaces; they were generously rewarded and sent away.
idiomatic: An edict kept their households and assigned them to the Dunmu, Jiqing, and Yongxing palaces; they were richly rewarded and sent home.

literal: In the twelfth month, on guiyou day, a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guiyou day, the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

literal: On jichou day Prince Longxu was born.
idiomatic: On jichou day Prince Longxu was born.

literal: That winter the court encamped at Jinchuan.
idiomatic: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Jinchuan.

literal: In the fifth year, on jiazi day of the first spring month, tithen Xiuge attacked the Tangut and defeated them, presenting the tally of captives.
idiomatic: In the fifth year, on jiazi day in the first spring month, tithen Xiuge attacked the Tangut, routed them, and reported the number of captives taken.

literal: Han sent tribute envoys.
idiomatic: Han sent tribute envoys.

literal: On gengwu day he mounted the Five Phoenix Tower to view the lanterns.
idiomatic: On gengwu day the Emperor mounted the Five Phoenix Tower to view the lanterns.

literal: In the second month, on dinghai day, the attendant Shiluli accidentally touched the spirit banner; by law he deserved death, but he was beaten and released.
idiomatic: In the second month, on dinghai day, the attendant Shiluli accidentally touched the spirit banner; though the law called for death, he was caned and released.

literal: On renchen day Prince of Yue Bishe presented the tally of Tangut captives.
idiomatic: On renchen day Prince of Yue Bishe presented the count of Tangut captives taken.

literal: On wushen day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On wushen day the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

literal: On xinhai day he visited New City.
idiomatic: On xinhai day the Emperor visited New City.

literal: In the third month, on the yimao new moon, he again visited New City.
idiomatic: On the yimao new moon of the third month the Emperor again visited New City.

literal: The empress's grandfather Humuli was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Han; bos Huolugu was granted concurrent Chief Councillor, and Niguzhi concurrent Palace Attendant.
idiomatic: The empress's grandfather Humuli was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Han; bos Huolugu was granted the concurrent title Chief Councillor, and Niguzhi concurrent Palace Attendant.

literal: That summer, in the fourth month on bingshen day, a white vapor was seen by day.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on bingshen day, a white vapor appeared in the daytime sky.

literal: In the fifth month, on guihai day, yuyue Wuzhi died; court was suspended for three days.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guihai day, yuyue Wuzhi died; court was suspended for three days.

literal: On xinwei day the Jurchen raided the border, killing supervisors Daliedie and Zhuaolawuilu and driving off the border people's cattle and horses.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the Jurchen raided the frontier, killing supervisors Daliedie and Zhuaolawuilu and seizing cattle and horses from the border population.

literal: On jimao day Asalan Uighur came to offer tribute.
idiomatic: On jimao day the Asalan Uighurs sent tribute.

literal: In the sixth month, on gengyin day, Jurchen chancellor and yilijin came to court.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengyin day, the Jurchen chancellor and yilijin came to court.

literal: On bingshen day Han sent men to report on Song affairs.
idiomatic: On bingshen day Han sent envoys to report on affairs with Song.

literal: That autumn, in the seventh month on gengchen day, Baoda Army Military Commissioner Yelü Xielidi was made Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on gengchen day, Baoda Army Military Commissioner Yelü Xielidi was appointed Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat.

literal: That month the court encamped at Swallow City.
idiomatic: That month the court encamped at Swallow City.

literal: In the ninth month, on renzi day, Biegude tribal chief Helutalan came to offer tribute.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi day, Biegude tribal chief Helutalan sent tribute.

literal: That winter, in the tenth month on dingyou day, he went to the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on dingyou day, the Emperor went to the Southern Capital.

literal: In the eleventh month, on the xinhai new moon, Yingli rebels the attendant Xiaoge, Huage, Xingu, and others were at last captured and executed.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinhai new moon, Xiaoge, Huage, Xingu, and other Yingli-era rebels among the attendants were at last captured and put to death.

literal: In the twelfth month, on wuxu day, Han was about to change its era name and sent envoys to report for imperial approval.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuxu day, Han planned to change its era name and sent envoys to seek imperial approval.

literal: That month he went to Guihua Prefecture.
idiomatic: That month the Emperor went to Guihua Prefecture.

literal: In the sixth year, on guiwei day of the first spring month, he visited the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: In the sixth year, on guiwei day in the first spring month, the Emperor visited the Southern Capital.

literal: In the third month Song sent envoys requesting peace; Youzhou Prefecture prefect Yelü Changzhu was additionally made Palace Attendant to negotiate peace with Song.
idiomatic: In the third month Song sent envoys seeking peace; Youzhou Prefecture prefect Yelü Changzhu was also made Palace Attendant to negotiate terms with Song.

literal: That summer, in the fourth month, Prince of Song Xiyin was deposed for plotting rebellion.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, Prince of Song Xiyin was deposed for plotting rebellion.

literal: That autumn, on the dingwei new moon of the seventh month, Gate Commissioner Zhuogu was additionally made honorary Grand Marshal and Censor-in-Chief; his son Haili, who had reported Xiyin's plot, was remotely appointed Defense Commissioner of Long Prefecture.
idiomatic: That autumn, on the dingwei new moon of the seventh month, Gate Commissioner Zhuogu was also made honorary Grand Marshal and Censor-in-Chief; his son Haili, who had reported Xiyin's conspiracy, was remotely appointed Defense Commissioner of Long Prefecture.

literal: On gengshen day he hunted at Level Ground Pine Forest.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the Emperor hunted at Level Ground Pine Forest.

literal: That winter, on the yihai new moon of the tenth month, he returned to the Supreme Capital.
idiomatic: That winter, on the yihai new moon of the tenth month, the Emperor returned to the Supreme Capital.

literal: In the twelfth month, on wuzi day, the monk Zhaomin was made chief overseer of monks and nuns throughout the Three Capitals and all circuits, additionally made Palace Attendant.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuzi day, the monk Zhaomin was appointed chief overseer of monks and nuns in the Three Capitals and all circuits and was also made Palace Attendant.

literal: In the seventh year, on the jiaxu new moon of the first spring month, Song sent envoys to offer congratulations.
idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the jiaxu new moon of the first spring month, Song sent envoys to offer congratulations.

literal: On renyin day he performed the full-moon sacrifice at Mount Muye.
idiomatic: On renyin day the Emperor performed the full-moon sacrifice at Mount Muye.

literal: In the second month, on guihai day, Han's Yanmen Military Commissioner Liu Jiwen came to court.
idiomatic: In the second month, on guihai day, Han's Yanmen Military Commissioner Liu Jiwen came to court.

literal: He presented local products as tribute.
idiomatic: He presented local products in tribute.

literal: On bingyin day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

literal: In the third month, on renwu day, Yelü Susa and others presented Tangut captives, which were distributed as gifts among the ministers.
idiomatic: In the third month, on renwu day, Yelü Susa and others presented Tangut captives, which were distributed among the ministers.

literal: That summer, in the fourth month, langjun Shansi was sent as envoy to Song.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, langjun Shansi was dispatched as envoy to Song.
